Wavelength in nm at which absorbance was measured (column in sample absorbance data files)
Method_ifapplicable: UV absorbance scans and excitation-emission matrices (EEMs) were collected simultaneously on filtered samples using an Aqualog (Horiba Scientific). Absorbance was measured from 230-800 nm in 3 nm intervals. EEMs were collected within the same wavelength constraints. Daily fresh Milli-Q water was used to obtain blank spectra. Absorbance data were blank-corrected prior to exporting data in the Aqualog software. Data were processed with the drEEM toolbox v. 6.0 for Matlab or using the fewsdom package (v1.1.5) in R (v4.3.2). Processing of the EEMs include blank correction, scatter line removal, inner filter effect and dilution correction, and normalization to Raman Scatter units based on daily water Raman scans collected at an excitation of 350 nm. Samples with absorbance at 254 nm above 0.3 were diluted and reanalyzed to maintain linearity between concentration and fluorescence intensity (Miller et al., 2010).
